orderForm.test.ts: buildZoneOrderRequest (single-Zone + ZoneToZone) uses entered coords + server-matched routeId/price

RouteOrderPage.test.tsx: Zone in-zone pickup -> Fixed quote -> order carries matched routeId; out-of-zone (non-Fixed) -> 'mimo zonu' + blocked; LOGGED-OUT in-zone -> quote runs anonymously-by-slug -> reaches inline login (not 'mimo zonu')

coverage_delta: +21 net tests (141 files, 890 tests, 0 failures; baseline was >=869). New files: zoneDraw.test.ts (7), ZonesTab.test.tsx (6). Migrated in place: priceQuote/usePriceQuote/PriceRangeBadge/CustomOrderPage/client/orderForm/RouteOrderPage.
notes: B1 quote union migration: getPriceQuote switched GET->POST with JSON body {pickupLat,pickupLng,dropoffLat?,dropoffLng?,at?} (byte-identical to A6 QuoteRequest, O-02). PriceQuoteResponse is now a discriminated union on `type`: Fixed{priceCzk,routeId,routeName} | Estimate{lowCzk,highCzk,distanceKm,durationMin} | Meter{baseCzk,perKmCzk,minimumCzk}. ALL consumers migrated (full-tree grep getPriceQuote|interpretQuote|PriceQuoteResponse|PriceQuoteRequest -> exactly 6 src files): client.ts, priceQuote.ts (interpretQuote now switch on `type`, added kind:'meter' + carries routeId/distanceKm/durationMin; was returning 'unknown' for Meter), usePriceQuote.ts (queryFn arg rename from->pickup), PriceRangeBadge.tsx (Meter -> 'Podle taximetru'), CustomOrderPage.test.tsx (M-02: all 4 mockQuote sites migrated to {type:'Estimate',...} shape). Driver priceBadgeUtils is DECOUPLED (reads ORDER dto priceType, not the quote response) -> regression-only, untouched, 10 tests stay green. The order-dto mock payloads in CustomOrderPage.test/RouteOrderPage.test keep priceType (order shape, A6 does not change it) - only quote mocks migrated. RouteOrderPage zone un-stub: Zone/ZoneToZone routes now render pickup (AddressAutocomplete + lazy PickupMap) + dropoff (ZoneToZone), run usePriceQuote, and are orderable ONLY when the server quote returns kind:'fixed' (pricing/quote IS the zone-validation mechanism per spec Lane-B item 6 - no client-side polygon check; ZoneService containment is authoritative server-side). Non-Fixed result -> 'mimo zonu' (customer.order.outsideZone) + submit blocked. New orderForm.buildZoneOrderRequest sends the quote's matched routeId + locked priceCzk (server-authoritative). AUTH-GATING (corrected after advisor review - the first cut had a real bug): usePriceQuote gained an opt-in allowAnonymous flag. CustomOrderPage stays token-gated (its quote is a preview, never a submit gate, so its 'no query when logged out' test still holds). RouteOrderPage passes allowAnonymous:true so the quote runs for a logged-out visitor who has a fleet slug (A6 widened pricing/quote to anonymous-by-slug; the customer PWA already sets X-Fleet-Slug). This is REQUIRED: a zone order can only submit on a Fixed match, so the Fixed match (zoneFixed) must resolve BEFORE login - otherwise a logged-out customer with a valid in-zone pickup gets 'mimo zonu' and never reaches the login step. Flow now: logged-out in-zone -> quote resolves Fixed -> 'v zone' confirm -> Objednat enabled -> inline login -> after login submit() succeeds (zoneFixed already set, no race). submitDisabled = createOrder.isPending || (isZone && !zoneFixed) - no longer hinges on auth. Old customer.order.zonePlaceholder key REMOVED from both locales (dead after un-stub). B2 Leaflet DRAW choice: HAND-ROLLED with react-leaflet@4.2.1 (already a dep; Node-20/vite-5 safe) - no react-leaflet-draw/leaflet-draw added (avoided the engine-check risk entirely). useMapEvents captures click (circle: 1st=center, 2nd=edge; polygon: append vertex) + dblclick (close polygon). Pure zoneDraw.ts is Leaflet-FREE (radius = own haversine, NOT L.latLng.distanceTo) so it unit-tests in jsdom; matches server ZoneService haversine. ZoneEditorMap is the lazy chunk (lazy(() => import('./ZoneEditorMap'))) - verified its own chunk ZoneEditorMap-*.js in dist and npm run size PASSES 220.3kB < 260kB budget (ZonesTab references it only via `import type` + lazy, no eager value import). Settings mount: added a 4th top-level SettingsPage tab 'Trasy a zony' rendering RoutesZonesPage (sub-tabs Zony/Trasy/Mista); Trasy/Mista are clean placeholder seams for B3/B4. router.tsx NOT modified (Settings is a single route with internal tabs) - no /d or /c route touched. ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY AT INTEGRATION (A4 parallel, envelope not pinned by its AC): getZones unwraps a {items} envelope (vehicles/staff CRUD convention; routes/common {routes} is the public-read outlier). Tests mock the client so they pass regardless - this is the {routes}/{items} envelope-bug class (CLAUDE.md); confirm against the real A4 ListZonesResponse. Also verify A6 QuoteResponse Meter arm field names (baseCzk/perKmCzk/minimumCzk) match - the client union is my best reading of the A6 tariff summary; priceQuote.ts Meter branch ignores those fields (renders a static label) so a field-name drift there is non-breaking for the customer UI.
